definition: to see something clearly in your mind
description: In an empty old factory hall with tall arched windows, warm sunbeams shine through the dusty air. A young woman with long dark hair, a denim shirt, cream trousers and white trainers smiles with her eyes closed and her arms spread out, then turns slowly in a full circle on the dusty floor and faces the front again, still smiling. A young man in a jacket leans in the doorway and watches her. Rubble, wooden pallets and a rusty wheelbarrow lie around the hall.

es.answer: Está girando bajo la luz del sol.
